questions: Fast arts still beat slow ones at the art lint, so this sheet gives both roads the enemy's own three arts. Is a slow Wood kit meant to be a real option?
No rule heals health in a fight, so regeneration on this road is linh lực only. Is that the intended meaning of Wood?
An enemy with five times the pool and a ward of 300 falls to ticks in 23 s and beats hits in 32 s. Is Wood's answer to Earth meant to be ticks?
